about: The scopes a run reads within (CHECK-13, ROW-2, ROW-4, ROW-8, OUTPUT-3, LOOKUP-8, WINDOW-3, WINDOW-7). A row count's when binds the groups it counts without changing its fraction's denominator; a named intermediate drives rows from its filtered records in stored order and groups them in first-occurrence order, and its column projection hides the fields it leaves out from a derivation and from a group key; a filtered source keeps its selected record's missing value in every arrival order; reordered key names keep their typed values and dependencies, and a missing key is refused apart from text that spells the missing marker, in either record order; and a row lag reads its partition's previous row, keeps construction order when ordered by its partition key, lags within its own template, reads completed lags and scalars, and two windows of one case column keep their own orderings. Moved from execution_retired_odm_context.rs, its scoped_windows_checks module. The report's check row is the line the row-count test found in the saved report, at the columns from NAME on. Each row-window test compared one output column; its case states the whole output, whose GRP, SEQ and VAL copy each input record's G, S and X in the row order the test's own column gives, and whose PREV, in the chained cases, is the lag the first case states for the same window. A test that saved is a save case with the bytes it compared, one whose save failed states that it saved nothing, a test that compared some fields of the issues names them in compares, and one that found its issue among others is among. Every other value is its test's.

documents.projected_driver:
yamaa: "1.0"
type: spec
domain: TEST
keys: [I]
input: {SRC: {path: input.csv, types: {I: int, V: int}}}
intermediates:
  - {id: DRV, dataset: SRC, columns: [V]}
columns:
  - {name: I, type: int}
rows:
  - id: selected
    dataset: DRV
    derivations:
      I: DRV.I
output: {path: out.csv, columns: [I]}
documents.missing_targets:
yamaa: "1.0"
type: spec
domain: EXAMPLE
keys: [GROUP_ID]
input:
  SOURCE: input.csv
output:
  path: example.csv
  columns: [GROUP_ID, TARGET_VALUE]
  order_by: [GROUP_ID]
columns:
  - name: GROUP_ID
    type: str
    label: Group Identifier
    derivation: SOURCE.GroupID
  - name: TARGET_VALUE
    type: str
    label: Target Value
    derivation:
      source:
        filter: "SOURCE.RecordKind = 'TARGET'"
        variable: SOURCE.Value

edits.from:
dataset: DRV
    derivations:
      I: DRV.I
      G: {str_case: {source: DRV.G, to: lower}}
      V: DRV.V
edits.to:
dataset: DRV
    group_by: [DRV.G]
    derivations:
      I: 0
      G: DRV.G
      V: {aggregate: 'SUM(DRV.V)'}

edits.from:
- {name: A, type: str, derivation: SRC.X}
  - {name: B, type: str, derivation: SRC.Y}
edits.to:
- {name: A, type: int, derivation: SRC.X}
  - {name: B, type: int, derivation: 'A + 1'}
types: {X: int, Y: str, Z: str}

edits.from:
- {name: A, type: str, derivation: SRC.X}
  - {name: B, type: str, derivation: SRC.Y}

edits.to: types: {X: int, Y: str, Z: str}

edits.from:
- {name: A, type: str, derivation: SRC.X}
  - {name: B, type: str, derivation: SRC.Y}

edits.to:
PREV: {row_value: {source: VAL, offset: -1, window: {order_by: [SEQ]}}}
  - id: b_only
    filter: "SRC.G = 'b'"
    derivations:
      GRP: SRC.G
      SEQ: SRC.S
      VAL: SRC.X
      PREV: {row_value: {source: VAL, offset: -1, window: {order_by: [SEQ]}}}

- {name: PREV, type: float}
  - {name: PREV2, type: float}

PREV: {row_value: {source: VAL, offset: -1, window: {group_by: [GRP], order_by: [SEQ]}}}
      PREV2: {row_value: {source: PREV, offset: -1, window: {group_by: [GRP], order_by: [SEQ]}}}

- name: PREV
    type: float
    derivation:
      case:
        - when: SEQ = 1
          then: {row_value: {source: VAL, offset: 1, window: {group_by: [GRP], order_by: [SEQ]}}}
        - otherwise: {row_value: {source: VAL, offset: 1, window: {group_by: [GRP], order_by: [{variable: SEQ, direction: desc}]}}}
